reason: The plugin is a client-side DeepSeek Harness web GUI enhancement that provides a sidebar navigation panel for conversation history by generating and clicking anchors tied to chat nodes, so its primary user-facing purpose is navigation within chat sessions rather than code generation, testing, or external integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI，在侧边栏生成会话锚点目录，用户可点击锚点快速跳转到对应的聊天节点位置。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a conversation anchor panel to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, listing chat nodes so users can click an item to jump to that message or event in the conversation.

capabilities: Builds a sidebar list of conversation nodes from the current chat snapshot
Navigates to specific chat entries by clicking anchors and scrolling the chat view
Updates anchor list when the active conversation or new messages change

reasons.code: README describes creating per-turn anchors for each visible user, assistant, tool, or command node and rendering them in the sidebar for navigation.
README and package metadata show the plugin is an out-of-tree DSH client extension that targets the web platform and performs browser-side behavior.
README states clicking anchors scrolls to `[data-chat-anchor-key]` elements, indicating direct DOM interaction in the host web UI.
